answer: To thwart Sybil swarms, the network anchors identity in a trusted execution kernel. Each autonomous agent must publish cryptographic attestation chains verifying hardware-isolated compute alongside zero-knowledge proofs of unique state history. A rogue swarm cannot crack this walnut shell defense without facing superlinear costs.
